case.component: BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA
case.narrative: The vehicle’s rear view camera continues to be unstable, even after the recent NHTSA-mandated software recall was installed. This recall DID NOT fix the issue. Ultimately, the vehicle’s computer hardware is underpowered and cannot run the latest software versions sufficiently, and that is the root of the flickering and crashing that occurs. Besides the rear view camera cutting out and saying “temporarily unavailable” the car’s automatic emergency braking system often mistakenly slams on the brakes, and because it’s controlled through the rear camera interface, you cannot safely disable it when these erroneous braking events occur as the screen becomes unresponsive or slow to respond.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
